title: Causal Clifford Theory (CL10): a quantum cellular automaton on Cl(10,0) — Standard Model kinematics, exactly unitary causal dynamics, and a lattice gravitational sector
description: A quantum cellular automaton is defined on a Planck lattice whose 2x2x2 cells carry the Clifford algebra Cl(10,0) on eight sub-sites (on-site space C^256) and are updated by one six-stage product of Spin(10) plane rotations and swap-rotations. This repository contains the full construction (doc/final_publication.md, 54 p) and its three companion papers (Paper I: core kinematics and unitarity; Paper II: the gauged bond layer and the lattice gravitational sector; Paper III: the loop-factor ladder and the phenomenology), together with the complete validation suite: 112 experiments, 112/112 PASS (run_validation.py). Every number quoted in the papers is produced by the open scripts in this repository. Results carry a provenance classification (algebraic, conventional, fitted, open); nine tensions with observation and seven falsifiers are reported rather than hidden.
references: M. Haouach, "Causal Clifford Theory (CL10): Minkowski kinematics, one anomaly-free generation, and exactly unitary causal dynamics from a single Clifford algebra" (Paper I, this repository, doc/paper1_core.pdf).

M. Haouach, "The gauged bond layer of Causal Clifford Theory: exact Gauss constraint, bounded area law, string tension, and the lattice gravitational sector" (Paper II, this repository, doc/paper2_gauge_gravity.pdf).

M. Haouach, "The loop-factor ladder and the phenomenology of Causal Clifford Theory: four scales, coupling unification, dark matter, neutrinos, and the provenance audit" (Paper III, this repository, doc/paper3_phenomenology.pdf).
